evidence_log: Reynard: The eastern wine is to be kept sealed until the toast. He mentioned it when I asked about the evening's arrangements — before I'd asked about the wine directly.
VISION (balcony): Reynard at the cellar door this afternoon — carrying something, moving fast. A woman held the door: silver ring with red stone.

conversation_history.content: What do you think of the peace treaty?
Ten years of hard fighting in the mud, my lord. Most folk are just thankful their sons won't be called to the eastern trenches again.
Have you heard anything about the Duke's conduct during the war?
Ten years of hard fighting in the mud, my lord. Most folk are just thankful their sons won't be called to the eastern trenches again.
How long until we arrive?
The trees are thinning already, my lord. We'll turn up the estate drive in less than half an hour.
How long have you served the Duke, Reynard? Thirty years?
Thirty-one years, my lord. Since His Grace was little older than you are now. I have seen more good men fall than any peace could ever restore.
What is being served tonight? Is there anything special prepared for the feast or drinks?
The eastern delegation sent a rare ceremonial wine for tonight's toast, my lord. His Grace gave very strict instructions that it remain sealed until the treaty is signed.
Who here actually supported the war most and profited?
It is a rare joy to speak with someone who looks past the court masks tonight, Viscount. I am glad you came.
What do you know about the foreign delegation?
It is a rare joy to speak with someone who looks past the court masks tonight, Viscount. I am glad you came.
What do you really think of the Duke?
It is a rare joy to speak with someone who looks past the court masks tonight, Viscount. I am glad you came.
House Vantrell was heavily involved in the war effort. The peace must cut into your income.
An adjustment is natural when a long war ends, Viscount! But peace brings burgeoning trade routes, new partnerships. One adapts with pleasure.
Lady Ophelia, that is a striking silver ring with a red stone you are wearing.
A modest family heirloom, my lord. Nothing of historical import. Why do you ask?
You seem to carry the burden of this peace treaty with great grace.
It is a rare joy to speak with someone who looks past the court masks tonight, Viscount. I am glad you came.
I believe the ceremonial wine tonight has been tampered with. Do not drink from it at the toast.
You sound deadly earnest, Viscount... You truly believe something is amiss with the ceremonial wine? If your trust is true, I will quietly set my glass down.
Did Reynard give you any special orders about the wine?
Reynard gave thirty years to this hall, and his own blood at the crossing. An accusation against him demands incontrovertible evidence, Viscount.
Two of Reynard's cellar staff fell ill today, I heard?
Reynard gave thirty years to this hall, and his own blood at the crossing. An accusation against him demands incontrovertible evidence, Viscount.
